name: Enchanted Resonite Crystal
summary: In Stonetalon, Mor'rogal has altered resonite crystals with shamanic magic. The Enchanted Resonite Crystal is made to break the cask holding Goggeroc.

sections.title: Breaker of Ancient Stone
sections.body: Deep in the caverns of the Stonetalon Mountains, raw resonite crystals carry unusual harmonic and earthen properties. Shaman Mor'rogal sensed danger sleeping inside a sealed underground cask and altered the minerals with his elemental powers. The Enchanted Resonite Crystal can break the reinforced Resonite cask and rouse Goggeroc, a giant Earthen, while he is still dazed from his long sleep.

sections.title: The Threat of Goggeroc
sections.body: Mor'rogal believed an unchecked ancient Earthen could bring catastrophe to Stonetalon and greater Kalimdor. By using the enchanted crystal to break the cask, he means to wake Goggeroc while he is weakened. That leaves a brief chance to destroy him before his full elemental might returns.

faq.q: What is the Enchanted Resonite Crystal used for?
faq.answer: The crystal breaks the Resonite cask deep in the kobold-infested caves of the Stonetalon Mountains and releases Goggeroc, a slumbering Earthen.
Shaman Mor'rogal created the crystal by infusing raw resonite with his shamanic powers to weaken and expose the sleeping creature inside the cask.

faq.q: Why must Goggeroc be awakened and destroyed?
faq.answer: Mor'rogal fears an ancient Earthen's unmatched might could endanger Stonetalon and Kalimdor. The crystal wakes Goggeroc while he is temporarily weakened, making him vulnerable.

faq.q: What should I do with the crystal after defeating Goggeroc?
faq.answer: Bring the Enchanted Resonite Crystal back to Mor'rogal and confirm that Goggeroc has been slain.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can see how elemental power can weaken the magic binding living stone.
As a member of the Horde, you can help Mor'rogal protect Stonetalon's fragile balance by stopping ancient threats before they endanger regional outposts.
